title: Minecraft Wither Skeleton Farm Tutorial - NEW! - 730 Heads P/H!
description:
In This Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make the easier and faster version of the wither skeleton mob farm without using any wither roses in Minecraft

📝Important Details About the Farm:
📚the farm is now based on a new delay method that doesn't hold mobs so much but still at 100% efficiency
📚Now the farm speed and rate are higher than before
📚Farm Rate depends on spawn proof, settings, and enchants that you are using
📚The Farm now uses a new mechanic based on the new pattern to despawn mobs we don't want at once!
📚and now the farm uses 2 wolves to trigger skeletons so much faster!

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
